form.label: Overview
form.description: Compact events in this Splunk, by source, and the event text volume they save.

search.query: | tstats count where `tenx-events` | eval ratio=max(1, ceiling(count/100000))

`tenx-events` | eval c=len(_raw) | `tenx-inflate` | eval o=len(_raw), bad=if(match(_raw, "^~"), 1, 0) | stats count as sampled sum(c) as c sum(o) as o sum(bad) as not_expanded by index sourcetype | append [| tstats count as events where `tenx-events` by index sourcetype] | stats sum(*) as * by index sourcetype | eval ratio=$ratio$, original_b=events*o/sampled, compact_b=events*c/sampled

| stats sum(original_b) as o sum(compact_b) as c | eval div=if(o>=1073741824, 1073741824, 1048576), unit=if(o>=1073741824, "GB", "MB") | eval v=round((o-c)/div, 1)." of ".round(o/div, 1)." ".unit | table v
| stats sum(original_b) as o sum(compact_b) as c | eval pct=round(100*(1-c/o)) | table pct
| stats sum(not_expanded) as n | table n

single.option: of the events checked; see Health

panel.title: Original against compact, by source type (MB of event text, from 1 in $ratio$ events)

search.query: | where sampled>0 | sort - original_b | eval Original=round(original_b/1048576, 1), Compact=round(compact_b/1048576, 1) | eval source=if(sourcetype=="tenx_encoded", index, sourcetype) | table source Original Compact

panel.title: By source: click a row to search its events as original text

search.query: | sort - events | eval Events=tostring(events, "commas"), "Original MB"=round(original_b/1048576, 1), "Compact MB"=round(compact_b/1048576, 1), "Saved %"=round(100*(1-c/o), 1) | rename index as Index, sourcetype as Sourcetype | table Index Sourcetype Events "Original MB" "Compact MB" "Saved %"
